name: Spooky Scary Gorillaz
summary:
Welcome to Spooky Scary Gorillaz — a dark, creepy playground where something is always watching.

Enter a haunted forest built for Gorilla-style movement, where every step and climb draws you deeper into the unknown. Using the familiar gorilla locomotion system, swing and scramble your way through a pixelated, low-light environment filled with strange shapes, eerie trees, and one very unsettling creature with glowing red eyes.

There’s no escape. No objective. Just you, the dark, and something waiting in it
